products.title: Our Main Wood & Plywood Products
products.subtitle: Our range satisfies all structural and industrial requirements, from high-density panels to raw round logs.

plywood.title: Engineered & Industrial Plywood
plywood.description: High-grade plywood suitable for industrial and commercial applications, luxury contracting, furniture frameworks, and environments subject to mechanical stress and moisture. Available in BB/BB and BB/CP grades with precise dimensions.

redPine.title: Red Pine Lumber
redPine.description: Kiln-dried red pine lumber, ideal for construction, general carpentry, architectural joinery, and door/window manufacturing.

spruce.title: Spruce Lumber (Whitewood)
spruce.description: Ultra-clean European whitewood lumber, engineered for commercial and industrial framing, concrete formwork, and industrial packaging.

birchLogs.title: Natural Birch Logs
birchLogs.description: Natural round birch logs imported and supplied directly for peeling mills, veneer production, high-density plywood, and woodworking industries.

aspenLogs.title: Aspen Round Logs
aspenLogs.description: High-demand aspen logs required for wood treatments, match factories, sauna construction, packaging boards, and crack-resistant light wood products.
